name: Bronx County, NY
findings: Bronx County has 2,987 nonprofit organizations. 910 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 727 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bronx County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
